title: Ideal-power torsion in the homology of ordered ringed Koszul stages
statement: Let R be a commutative ring sheaf on a small site, r,n natural numbers, and b a family of r global sections. For the ordered tensor Koszul system [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], for every integer q and site object X, the (r*(n+1)+1)-st power of the ideal generated by the b_j(X) annihilates every section over X of the homology sheaf H^q((ringedKoszulDiagram R r b).obj n). This includes r=0 and all integer degrees.

source.place: Tag 0626 (lemma-homotopy-koszul-abstract) and lemma-homotopy-koszul; ordered factor model in Tag 0913

proof.text: For a natural scalar endomorphism z, construct the contraction of double(z.app P) by the degree-one-to-degree-zero identity, using the two double-complex degree isomorphisms. Its homotopy equation follows from naturality of z.

Scalar multiplication on a sheaf tensor product can be placed on either factor, checked on pure tensors. Tensor the two-term contraction through the other ordered factors using the total-complex homotopy bifunctor and its signs. Each generator to exponent n+1 therefore acts null-homotopically on its entire ordered Koszul stage.

Apply homology and scalar naturality, then evaluate sections: each generator power kills each homology section. Reuse the finite-generator ideal-power lemma to put the power r*(n+1)+1 in the annihilator. When r=0 this is the zero ideal to power one.

lean.statement:
theorem ordered_koszul_ideal_power_annihilates_homology
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin r → (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (q : ℤ) (X : Cᵒᵖ) (a : R.obj.obj X),
      a ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin r ↦ (b j).val X))) ^
        (r * (n + 1) + 1) →
      ∀ x : (((ringedKoszulDiagram R r b).obj n).homology q).val.obj X,
        a • x = 0
